//: Security headers for the web app (Phase 10). Used by `vite preview` (so browser tests run under them) and by the Vercel build. Copy them to any other host. style-src needs 'unsafe-inline' for React style attributes; no inline scripts are used.
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'
